parrafo_1.en: Dr. Drip Plumbing is a residential plumbing business based in Cutler Bay. Justin and his team show up, explain the problem clearly, and handle everything from water heaters to septic systems.

parrafo_2.es: Responden incluso en fin de semana y de noche: varias resenas en Google destacan que llegaron el mismo dia, incluso un sabado por la tarde, para resolver una emergencia.
parrafo_2.en: They answer even on weekends and at night: several Google reviews point out they showed up the same day, including a Saturday evening, to solve an emergency.
